note: Set A captures more distinct, correctly bound facts from the page — base diameter and thickness, Young's and shear moduli, the 8,500 kg/m3 effective density with its paint/bolts/welds/flanges rationale, the 7,850 kg/m3 steel reference, the 30% thickness increase, and several correctly keyed Table 6-1 rows (TMassDen, TwEAStif, TwSSStif, TwSSIner) plus the 38.234 m mass center. Set B's table values are mostly right but it repeats the same facts (mass 347,460 kg three times, density three times, Young's modulus twice) and misreads the stiffness unit as N*m^3 in three claims, and it misbinds 80.8 GPa as 'yield strength' when the text calls it the shear modulus. Set A does contain two fabricated table entries (TwFAlSef 218.3 N/m and TwFASStiff 614.5) and one row mislabel (4688.0 kg·m is the 87.60 m row, not 'Row 10'), plus a couple of non-verbatim quote paraphrases. On balance A is the more faithful and better-covered extraction despite those slips.
